proposal.hypothesis: Under conditions where the driving force amplitude (F_0) is small relative to the inherent damping forces, or when the driving frequency ($\Omega$) is significantly detuned from the natural frequency ($\omega_0$), the Root Mean Square (RMS) displacement of the driven system will be statistically indistinguishable from the undriven reference oscillator.
proposal.question: Does periodic driving increase RMS displacement against an otherwise matched damped oscillator?
